title: Post-earthquake glass cleanup boundary
summary: A safe boundary for broken glass after an earthquake, aftershock, shelf collapse, window failure, or shop damage when shoes, pets, children, and darkness increase injury risk.
content: Core sequence: 1) Put shoes on everyone before any cleanup, including people who were asleep. 2) Move children and pets to a glass-free room or marked area before sweeping. 3) Use cardboard, stiff paper, or a dustpan from the edge inward; do not pick invisible shards with bare fingers. 4) Mark the cleaned path as passable but continue checking feet, paws, bedding, bags, and food surfaces.
materials: stiff cardboard glass scoop prepared specifically for Post-earthquake glass cleanup boundary
